messages:
aj: ping — PR #54231 (private-deploy/kms-rollout) needs final steward + sec approval. Proposed merge Fri 09:00 PT. Who can take?

sylvie: I can take merge steward if infra can confirm slot. what's the minimum rollout plan?

aj: minimal plan in PR: CMK policy update, console rollout flag, canary script, kv-cache eviction test results. HSM optional. I'll attach the policy diff.

devin: runtime quick check: code LGTM but we saw an eviction spike in local canary `./scripts/e2e_canary.sh --load 80%`. I'll add logs to PR and a repro.

jamal: infra can cover merge stewardship. Thu is tight for oncall; prefer Fri 09:00 PT. I'll block slot.

riley: security here. Quick Qs: does the KMS change introduce new principals or role widening? if not, I'll do a lightweight review and aim EOD Thu.

aj: no new principals, just CMK policy tightening and alias swap. attaching diff now.

carol: I'll own rollout flags and console telemetry. propose canary: 10% 2h, 50% 4h, full. need telemetry hooks and alerts enabled.

sylvie: added merge-steward checklist to PR. tagging @oncall for infra load awareness.

merge-bot: requested reviewers updated: [sylvie, jamal, riley, carol, devin]

aj: uploaded eviction snapshot and repro instructions: `tools/repro/evict-repro.py --duration 120`. moving merge to Fri 09:00 PT per infra.

jamal: confirmed Fri 09:00 PT slot reserved.

riley: security pass done, left comments, added `security:approved` label. no IAM widening.

carol: telemetry hooks look good. I'll monitor dashboards during canary.

devin: logs and reproducer added. please run the repro during canary window.

aj: thanks all — action items: 1) aj attach CMK diff & repro, 2) devin add eviction logs, 3) carol enable telemetry, 4) riley sec sign-off, 5) jamal reserve merge slot. I'll merge after canary if metrics stable :thumbsup:
